rules.message: Binary uses NSUserDefaults but PrivacyInfo.xcprivacy does not declare NSPrivacyAccessedAPICategoryUserDefaults reason.
rules.remediation: Add NSPrivacyAccessedAPICategoryUserDefaults to NSPrivacyAccessedAPITypes in PrivacyInfo.xcprivacy with one of: CA92.1, AC6.1, C56D.1.

rules.message: Binary uses File Timestamp APIs but PrivacyInfo.xcprivacy does not declare NSPrivacyAccessedAPICategoryFileTimestamp reason.
rules.remediation: Add NSPrivacyAccessedAPICategoryFileTimestamp to NSPrivacyAccessedAPITypes with one of: C617.1, 3B52.1, 0A2A.1, DDA9.1.

rules.message: Binary uses System Boot Time APIs but PrivacyInfo.xcprivacy does not declare NSPrivacyAccessedAPICategorySystemBootTime reason.
rules.remediation: Add NSPrivacyAccessedAPICategorySystemBootTime to NSPrivacyAccessedAPITypes with one of: 35F9.1, 8FFB.1, 3D61.1.

rules.message: Binary uses Disk Space APIs but PrivacyInfo.xcprivacy does not declare NSPrivacyAccessedAPICategoryDiskSpace reason.
rules.remediation: Add NSPrivacyAccessedAPICategoryDiskSpace to NSPrivacyAccessedAPITypes with one of: E174.1, 85F4.1, 7D9E.1, B728.1.

rules.message: Binary references ASIdentifierManager.advertisingIdentifier but Info.plist lacks NSUserTrackingUsageDescription (required since iOS 14.5).
rules.remediation: Add NSUserTrackingUsageDescription string entry to Info.plist explaining why your app needs tracking permission.

rules.message: Info.plist does not declare ITSAppUsesNonExemptEncryption; App Store Connect will prompt for export-compliance answers on every upload.
rules.remediation: Add ITSAppUsesNonExemptEncryption boolean to Info.plist (false for standard HTTPS/CommonCrypto usage; true requires export documentation).
